metadata.datasource: Generated with spektrafilm_profile_builder 0.1.0 from digitised data-sheet curves. KODAK technical data TI-2323 (September 2005 (Revised 9-05)), ti2323.pdf, PDF page(s) 7;8, KODAK EKTACHROME Professional Infrared EIR Film: https://filmcolors.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/ti2323.pdf (catalogued at https://filmcolors.org/timeline-entry/40700/) Estimate placeholders (not on the sheet): infrared sensitivity beyond spektrafilm's spectral grid is dropped: the cyan-forming (infrared-sensitive) layer only sees its visible / near-IR tail, so foliage and other IR-reflecting subjects do not turn red as on the real film (RGB input carries no infrared); no No. 12 (yellow) filter in the model: all three layers keep the blue sensitivity printed on the sheet; dye densities outside the printed 400-700 nm (held below, exponential decay above); sensitivity tails beyond the printed curves; hanatos2025 adaptation parameters (averaged from pinned Kodak reversal profiles); interlayer DIR coupler strength (not on any data sheet). Original data are property of the respective holders.
